dataPost.title: Weather App
dataPost.subtitle: Expo + React Native
dataPost.description: A mobile weather app with current conditions, an hourly forecast, and a 7-day forecast with expandable details — built with Expo Router. My goal wasn't just a clean UI, but the full cycle: API integration, state management, and handling incomplete data.
dataPost.highlight: During testing I found a subtle API/UI mismatch — the UI always expected 7 forecast days, but the API sometimes returned fewer. I traced the root cause, refactored the rendering logic, and made the forecast title dynamic based on real data.
